newsitem.title: CHINA: Hong Kong graft busters move against exam cheats.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong graft busters move against exam cheats.

text.p: Hong Kong's anti-corruption police, usually busy tackling multi-million dollar frauds and bribery scandals, have now been called in to tackle a case of suspected cheating in this year's high school leaving exams.
The Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC) said it had investigated a leak of exam papers for this summer's exams.

The examination authority called in the graft busters after a student obtained unusally high results across the board, and an examination officer was suspected of taking photocopies of exam papers and passing them to a candidate, officials said.
An examination officer has been charged by the ICAC with conspiracy to defraud the examination body, and was due to appear in court on Wednesday, an ICAC spokesperson said.
